subject.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe

question: Should bundled LSP server keys that currently produce unsafe or colliding tool names be migrated unconditionally to the PR's deterministic provider-safe names while already-valid complete names remain unchanged?
rationale: The code defect and repair are clear, but accepting model-facing name changes for existing bundle configurations is an upgrade-contract decision rather than a correctness question automation can settle.

options.title: Approve bounded migration
options.body: Accept the deterministic provider-safe names for unsafe and colliding keys, preserve already-valid complete names, refresh onto current main, and land after exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Require explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Ask for an opt-in or migration surface before changing any previously exposed unsafe names, at the cost of retaining a provider-dependent failure path.

options.title: Pause naming policy
options.body: Hold the PR until bundle MCP and LSP naming are redesigned behind one explicitly documented shared contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded migration
recommendation.body: Accept the deterministic provider-safe names for unsafe and colliding keys, preserve already-valid complete names, refresh onto current main, and land after exact-head gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes this compatibility question to steipete and the decision spans agent runtime and bundle upgrade policy.
